title: Broken Report
summary: Debug a Quarto document: a YAML header that won't parse, a setup chunk in the wrong order, inline code that isn't, and a number typed by hand.
hints: A colon inside a YAML value confuses YAML (it looks like another key). Put the title in quotes: `title: "Crew Log Report: Draft"`.
R runs a chunk top to bottom: `read_csv()` only exists after `library(readr)`.
Inline code needs the `r`: `` `r format(nrow(crew), big.mark = ",")` ``. And the median: `` `r round(median(crew$hours_mission))` ``.
